entities.summary: Katherine Clare Timpf is an American libertarian columnist, television personality, reporter, and comedian. She is a regular panelist on Fox News Channel's Gutfeld! and appears as a contributor on various other Fox News shows. In 2017, Timpf co-hosted Fox News Specialists alongside Eric Bolling and Eboni K. Williams. Beginning in 2019, she has hosted the Fox Nation show Sincerely, Kat.
